ITEM 1 | Scrambled mass of pale yellow-orange pieces with soft, crumbly, slightly glossy curds and small clumps, covering roughly 30% of the plate in a mound about 10 cm long and 5 cm wide, about 2.5 cm tall at the thickest point, sitting at the left-center of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Bright red sliced pieces, glossy and moist with slightly translucent edges, several wedges each about 3-4 cm long and 1 cm thick, clustered at the upper-left edge of the plate and covering roughly 8% of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Dark green leafy greens with smooth, slightly glossy surfaces and visible stems, wilted and folded, covering about 15% of the upper-right area of the plate in a pile about 8 cm across and 2 cm tall | 45
ITEM 4 | Dark green floret clusters with tiny bumpy tops and pale green stalks, slightly charred or darkened tips, lying beside the leafy greens on the right side, covering about 6% of the plate in pieces about 4-5 cm across and 2 cm tall | 35
